title: FBI says SafePay ransomware gang ‘among most active’ with more than 600 victims since 2024
content_md: Jonathan Greig reports: At least 600 organizations across the U.S. and Europe have been breached by the SafePay ransomware gang since August 2024, according to a new advisory from international law enforcement agencies. The FBI and cybersecurity agencies in Germany as well as the U.K. said SafePay is now “among the most active ransomware groups… Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/10/27/fbi-says-safepay-ransomware-gang-among-most-active-with-more-than-600-victims-since-2024/
